title: The Beginning of Your Relationship with the Family of God
description: A lesson focused on helping the disciple grow in connection, fellowship, and participation in the family of God.

cards.heading: Sharing Your Week with God
cards.scriptureText: Taste and see that the Lord is good.
cards.body: Share what you have experienced with the Lord during the past week. Encourage your disciple to share what they are learning about Jesus, especially from their reading in the Gospel of Mark.
cards.question: What have you discovered about Jesus this past week?

cards.heading: Reviewing God’s Word
cards.scriptureText: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
cards.body: Review previously learned verses to strengthen understanding and memory. God’s Word helps build a strong foundation in the Christian life.
cards.question: What do these verses mean to you personally?

cards.heading: Understanding the Cell Group
cards.scriptureText: They broke bread in their homes and ate together with glad and sincere hearts.
cards.body: A cell group is a place of fellowship, encouragement, and spiritual growth. It allows believers to support one another and grow together in their faith.
cards.question: How do you understand the purpose of a cell group?

cards.heading: Growing Through Fellowship
cards.scriptureText: Let us consider how we may spur one another on toward love and good deeds.
cards.body: Building relationships with other believers is important. Spend time connecting with others, visit, talk, and grow together in faith and friendship.
cards.question: How can you build stronger relationships with others in your group?

cards.heading: Caring for One Another
cards.scriptureText: Carry each other’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.
cards.body: Being part of God’s family means caring for one another. Pray for fellow members and be aware of their needs.
cards.question: How can you support someone in your group this week?

cards.heading: Sharing the Gospel with Others
cards.scriptureText: Go and make disciples of all nations.
cards.body: Every believer is called to share the gospel. Think about your family and friends who need to know Jesus and begin praying for them.
cards.question: Who is one person you want to share Jesus with?

cards.heading: Prayer for Others
cards.scriptureText: Prayers... be made for all people.
cards.body: Pray for your group, your friends, and those who need to know Christ. Prayer connects us to God and to one another.
cards.question: Who will you commit to pray for this week?

cards.heading: Next Steps
cards.scriptureText: Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it.
cards.body: Set your next meeting and continue growing through obedience to God’s Word. Make Bible reading and fellowship part of your regular life.
cards.question: What step will you take this week to grow in God’s family?
